text:
Jia: Pushed quantized v2 (int8) of orion-3b to staging overnight. Quick smoke shows JP->EN translations where Kanji+Katakana sequences are being split/merged oddly. Sample below — small reproduction.
Mira: Which tokenizer version did you use? paste detok + tokens please.
Jia: Tokenizer v0.9.1 (new merge table). detok/raw:
Original string: 東京タワー
Baseline tokenization: [\"東京\", \"タワー\"]
Int8-staging tokenization: [\"東京タ\", \"ワー\"]
Model output baseline: \"Tokyo Tower\"
Model output int8: \"TokyoTa wara\"
Ari: Hmm. Could be kernel reorder with quantized matmul + changed split-KV behavior. Seen similar when fused kernel fallback picks a different chunking.
Tom: I rolled fused-kernel v3 yesterday (uses split-kv caching trick). Do we have a quick python check? e.g.
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode('東京タワー').tokens)
```
Jia: Ran a 200-sample JP news-smoke: BLEU dropped ~2.3 vs baseline (news-test). Failure cluster: Katakana appended to preceding Han char -> broke detokenization spacing for EN output.
Mira: Can you bisect? Was the tokenizer merge table changed in the quantization pipeline or earlier in model onboarding?
Jia: Repro steps I used:
1) git checkout abc1234 (pre-quant commit)
2) scripts/quantize.sh --model orion-3b --scheme=int8
3) python tests/lang/jp_smoke.py --samples 200
I toggled quant flags: --use-fused-kernel true/false and saw different token splits.
Tom: If fused-kernel flips computation order, it can change the tokenization path if we accidentally reserialize bytes differently. But tokenizer is separate — maybe we ship a different tokenizer.json to staging. @Mira any packaging changes in build pipeline?
Mira: Packaging unchanged AFAIK, but I did update the merge table artifact yesterday when onboarding orion-3b v2. I'll pin old merge table to test.
Ari: Short-term mitigation: pin tokenizer merge table to v0.9.0 in staging and rerun smoke. Longer-term: add per-locale tokenization diff checks in the onboarding harness.
Mira: I'll open PR to pin merges + add failing sample to regression suite. Also adding a Console eval job to track JP token-level mismatch and BLEU over time.
ops-bot: ops-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 1724300300 by @Mira :rocket:
Jia: Thanks — running full regen now, will post logs and a minimal failing sample for bisecting kernels vs tokenizer artifacts.
Tom: I'll start a kernel bisect in parallel. If it's tokenizer.json, we can hotfix artifact; if it's kernel, fallback to non-fused kernel for critical customers.
Mira: Good plan. Tagging @eng-ml for visibility. :eyes:
Jia: Posted failing sample + raw logits (trimmed) to the thread: 
```
input: 東京タワー
baseline_tokens: [東京, タワー]
staging_tokens: [東京タ, ワー]
baseline_logits: [..]
staging_logits: [..]
```
Ari: Nice repro. Keep notes on whether ZWJ/ZWSP handling differs — I suspect a normalization quirk in merge table generation.
Tom: Will report back by EOD with bisect status.
Mira: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with PR link and deploy outcome. :thumbsup:
